shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar with a wide flat top block over a narrower shaft
animal in profile carved in low relief on the pillar shaft
quadruped with head turned/lowered, legs indicated
narrow raised band or register line across the pillar face
justification: Both surfaces are the broad face of a T-shaped monolith bearing low-relief animals in profile arranged on the shaft below the wide head block, rendered in the same flattened, outline-and-raised-plane convention with schematic limbs and simple heads. A depicts a dense, multi-register program (a row of repeated crouching quadrupeds along the top, a fringed band, a bird-headed creature, a small human-like figure and a large long-necked bird below) while B shows only a single sparse quadruped on an otherwise plain face, so the compositional density and specific subjects differ considerably.
